scope: Each connector compares observed average precision with the complete-random-ranking expectation for that query’s retained gallery. Own-identity and shared-plate-map exclusions remain in force. The random expectation is not a confidence interval or a biological null test. An annotation match does not demonstrate a molecular target or mechanism. Ineligible queries remain in the table and are not plotted as zero. The chart preserves saved query order and shows no classifier results; no model was refit.
